crossRefs.note: Truly, Yahweh, the kings of Assyria have destroyed all the countries and their land,
and have cast their gods into the fire; for they were no gods, but the work of men’s hands, wood and stone; therefore…
Whom have you defied and blasphemed? Against whom have you exalted your voice and lifted up your eyes on high? Against…
They will be disappointed, yes, confounded, all of them. Those who are makers of idols will go into confusion together.
Israel will be saved by Yahweh with an everlasting salvation. You will not be disappointed nor confounded to ages…
Pharaoh said, “Who is Yahweh, that I should listen to his voice to let Israel go? I don’t know Yahweh, and moreover I…
Whom have you defied and blasphemed? Against whom have you exalted your voice and lifted up your eyes on high? Against…
Now therefore don’t let Hezekiah deceive you, nor persuade you in this way. Don’t believe him, for no god of any nation…
They spoke of the God of Jerusalem as of the gods of the peoples of the earth, which are the work of men’s hands.
Because he has stretched out his hand against God, and behaves himself proudly against the Almighty,
he runs at him with a stiff neck, with the thick shields of his bucklers,
Or do you have an arm like God? Can you thunder with a voice like him?
You have done these things, and I kept silent. You thought that I was just like you. I will rebuke you, and accuse you…
They have set their mouth in the heavens. Their tongue walks through the earth.
Now if you are ready whenever you hear the sound of the horn, flute, zither, lyre, harp, pipe, and all kinds of music…

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: Who are they among all the gods of these countries that have delivered their country out of my hand, that Yahweh should deliver Jerusalem out of my hand?’ ”
translations.bsb: Who among all the gods of these lands has delivered his land from my hand? How then can the LORD deliver Jerusalem from my hand?”
translations.kjv: Who are they among all the gods of these lands, that have delivered their land out of my hand, that the LORD should deliver Jerusalem out of my hand?
translations.asv: Who are they among all the gods of these countries, that have delivered their country out of my hand, that Jehovah should deliver Jerusalem out of my hand?
